case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You pointed to labour and material costs behind your price. Our options answer that with a longer contract term, which gives your plant a firm basis for planning. Option A is the package we can approve: it commits us to the longest term on offer, and the quality record below shows what a dependable partner you would be tied to.

On quality:
Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As you do not decide on your own, please take Option A to the person who does. It gives your company a binding multi-year agreement and a customer that is committed to you.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your counter-offer and the proposed 24-month contract term, which we are happy to accept. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. That does not change our position. Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, our colleagues will address this separately.

Our main offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, for the 24-month term and 45 days payment, we can offer a revised price of €4.90 per unit. Specifically, this alternative features a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You said that material is the core of your cost and that the quality record holds.

That term is what Option A builds on. It gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd a firm basis for planning and a binding commitment over the full period, which matters more than a one-off price step.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. We would like to settle this as one family-minded partner to another, in a way that works for both companies.

As you are the one handling this for your side, we ask you to take Option A to the person who decides at your company, so that we can close it together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and the increase in your proposed prices. As a dedicated distributor, we always value our partnership and look forward to serving your ongoing needs from our extensive product range. 

In response to your movement, we can make a minor adjustment to our price for the 45-day payment term. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we propose a unit price of €4.89 for the 24-month contract with 45 days payment. This option offers a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You asked which figures our position rests on, and you said that material makes up the largest part of your cost. Our options do not ask you to give up on it.

Option A is the package we can approve.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As you are not the one who decides alone, we would ask you to take Option A to the person who does.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We always value you as a customer and take great pride in supporting your business with our extensive product range and dedicated service. 

Regarding our current negotiations, please be assured that I am fully authorized to make this decision on behalf of our company. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our terms stand at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

We hope these conditions suit your needs, and we look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure to serve you with our broad range and high-standard service, and we look forward to continuing our great cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
